description: Service split for the typesafe provider. Ordered path rules (JavaScript regex against the full path key), first match wins; every operation path must match a rule or bin/split.mjs and build_inventory.mjs fail without writing. The published API has two operations: the System One evaluation endpoint (the inference plane, service `systemone`) and the models catalog (the control plane, service `models`). A new upstream path that matches neither rule fails the build so it is classified deliberately.
